# HEILC — AI & Digital Transformation Agency

> HEILC builds custom AI products, machine learning models and enterprise software that reach production — evaluated against a golden dataset, deployed in the client's own cloud account, and monitored after launch.

## Overview
HEILC is an AI and digital transformation agency founded by Pardhasaradhi Menda and Varshith Dondamuri, based in Chennai, India, working with clients worldwide. The agency takes problems from the decision the software has to support through to a deployed, documented system.

## Case studies
- **GeneRisk AI** — DNA-sequence cancer risk classifier, XGBoost, 97.37% accuracy on held-out test data, Flask API and React dashboard on Railway. https://www.heilc.com/case-studies/generisk-ai
- **CineGenome** — Film recommendation engine over 3,477 films decomposed into visual, narrative, audio and emotional dimensions with Claude and Pinecone. https://www.heilc.com/case-studies/cinegenome
- **ResumeAI** — Resume builder with live ATS scoring and a three-strategy JSON parser, built in 24 hours at the AppXcelerate 1.0 hackathon on Groq LLaMA. https://www.heilc.com/case-studies/resumeai

- Next.js / React / TypeScript / Tailwind CSS

- AWS / GCP / Azure / Vercel / Railway
